t: The Market-Aware Forever Machine: Navigation Engineering with SEMRush Gravity
s: Evolves a content hierarchy from semantic clustering to a market-aware, anti-fragile navigation engine by integrating SEMRush search volume and GSC performance data with D3.js force-directed graphs and Verlet integration.
sub: D3.js force graph for dynamic content hierarchy visualization
Integrating SEMRush search volume & GSC data for market-aware site structure
Leveraging LLMs as actuators for anti-fragile automated systems
Physics simulation (Coulomb's Law, Hooke's Law) to stabilize knowledge topology
Weighted K-Means clustering for value-based content architecture
